task_title: Emulate build expiry with bounded reconciliation and merge train

plan_review.notes: Adversarial alternatives: serial exact-SHA queue rejected because it sacrifices the bounded six-PR throughput goal; mirror PR branches rejected because original PR heads would not become ancestors of main and merged-state semantics would remain unresolved; a staging branch rejected because it adds state without removing the need for exact original-PR promotion. Review added flag-off cleanup, trusted-promotion-only main CI suppression, red-main circuit breaking, final reattestation, bounded merged-state postconditions, and past-only deterministic timestamps. Chosen architecture remained intact; divergence=minor.
